eld.text: In Throne of Eldraine, the planeswalkers Oko and Garruk Wildspeaker kidnap High King Algenus Kenrith, disrupting Eldraine's status quo, after Oko traps and mesmerizes Garruk into a servile bodyguard.
The twins Rowan and Will Kenrith set out on a quest to save their father, and Will rescues the cursed Garruk, who is cured by the Cauldron of Eternity.
Oko, disguised as Queen Ayara, shoots the stag during the Wild Hunt, and Rowan's protest stops Garruk as Oko planeswalks away.
Linden restores the High King with his sword, and learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' shared spark and they planeswalk away.

woe.text: In Wilds of Eldraine, Eldraine lies under the Wicked Slumber, cast by Talion and the three witch sisters to halt the Phyrexian invasion, which saves the plane but does not lift when the invasion ends.

Talion sends the sixteen-year-old Kellan to defeat the witch sisters and end the curse in exchange for information about his father, and Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane.

On sleeping Eldraine, Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allies with Eriette, until at Castle Ardenvale Kellan restrains them and Will strikes them with an ice bolt, forcing them to planeswalk away.
Kellan declines Talion's reward and learns from his mother that his father is the planeswalker Oko.
